integrity.proof_scope: All candidate 4-vertex deletion sets in a 14-vertex graph, all legal exchanges and all-sources jump distances.
integrity.reproduction: Two independent deterministic Node.js verifiers; union-find complement-forest enumeration and separate all-simple-cycle hitting-set enumeration. Outputs and source programs included.

limitations: The exact classification concerns GP(7,2), with only n=5,6 as an initial-sequence cutoff. It is a finite exhaustive computation with a lower-bound proof, not an infinite-family classification. Independent scholarly assessment and historical priority review are outstanding.
title: A mixed token-slide phase and a connected jump metric for minimum decycling sets of \(GP(7,2)\)
